instruction: On the command line, flip the image vertically (top to bottom) and save as "flipped.png".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires vertically flipping the image (mirror top-bottom). The evaluator checks if the result is the vertical mirror of the source by comparing SSIM after flipping. Verified by generating expected output with PIL's FLIP_TOP_BOTTOM transpose.
